samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for contacting me about walking as a daily habit. I am writing to offer some suggestions in response to your request. I understand that you would like a practical starting point, and I hope the following advice will be useful.

Thank you for contacting me about [chủ đề]. I am writing to offer some suggestions in response to your request. I understand that you would like a practical starting point, and I hope the following advice will be useful.

paragraphs.label: Đề xuất đầu
paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a neighbourhood walking event. This would give you an opportunity to explore a short local route and note useful improvements. One potential benefit is that people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip.

paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a simple home cooking class. This would give you an opportunity to prepare an affordable meal using basic equipment. One potential benefit is that people have more control over their meals and spending. For example, a student can prepare rice, vegetables and eggs instead of ordering food every evening.

paragraphs.text: I would recommend attending a beginner community sports session. This would give you an opportunity to try simple team games in a friendly group.
